title: The Blood-Pulse Method
lines: Han Sen stood at the edge of the slaughter field, his heart pounding. Every year, the Empire tested its youth: survive against a sacred-blood creature, or die trying. Those who succeeded became Evolvers. Those who failed were not spoken of again.

He had no money, no family name, no inherited techniques. His only advantage was the strange, pulsing hum in his blood — a sensation he had felt since his twelfth birthday, when he was bitten by a creature in the forbidden zone and should have died.

The sacred-blood creature emerged from the mist — a Three-Eyed Jaguar, its third eye glowing with dormant psychic power. Han Sen gripped his alloy blade, a cheap model that had cost him every credit he owned. It was not enough. It was never enough.

But when the jaguar lunged and its claws raked his chest, something inside Han Sen awakened. His blood responded before his mind could — the pulse accelerated, his muscles hardened, and for one blinding moment he moved faster than thought.

He drove the blade through the jaguar's third eye. The creature collapsed. The watching evaluators were stunned. They had tested a thousand candidates that month, and none had killed a sacred-blood creature with an unenhanced alloy blade.
